house.description: Hmong Zej Zog funding provided to preserve Hmong Minnesotans' heritage, history, language, and culture; and money appropriated.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Legacy Finance

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money to Hmong Zej Zog to preserve Hmong Minnesotans' heritage, history, language, and culture.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; HMONG ZEJ ZOG. +]

[+$300,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $300,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of administration for a grant to Hmong Zej Zog to preserve Hmong Minnesotans' heritage, history, language, and culture. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money to Hmong Zej Zog to preserve Hmong Minnesotans' heritage, history, language, and culture.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; HMONG ZEJ ZOG.

$300,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $300,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of administration for a grant to Hmong Zej Zog to preserve Hmong Minnesotans' heritage, history, language, and culture.
additions: $300,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $300,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of administration for a grant to Hmong Zej Zog to preserve Hmong Minnesotans' heritage, history, language, and culture.
